name: 2D Polygon Edge to Sparse Boundary Conversion
aliases: 2D Vector Edge to Sparse Boundary Conversion
definition: A method to convert 2D polygon edges into a sparse boundary grid using XOR operations, without considering polygon interiors. It serves as the first stage of a two-stage rasterization process.
summary: This method converts 2D polygon edges into a sparse boundary grid using bitwise XOR operations on area identifiers, decoupling boundary extraction from interior filling to uniformly handle any closed watertight primitive.
